cloakroom: Secure luggage and electronic gadget storage cloakrooms are operated directly by Srisailam Devasthanam right in front of the queue-line complex for nominal charges.
drinking_water: Cool spring water available from holy water bodies like Rudradhara, Bhasma Gundam, and Gouri Gundam at Umamaheshwaram, flowing continuously even during summer.
toilets: Multiple public restrooms and sanitation blocks with continuous water supply are situated near the queue complex, CRO, and main temple entrances.
footwear_counter: Dedicated free and nominal-fee footwear safe-keeping counters are managed near all major entry points to the temple complex.
annadanam: Free meal facilities (Annadaanam) provided at Srisailam and gateway precincts like Tripuranthakam.
wheelchair_accessibility: Battery-operated buggies, wheelchairs, priority darshan lines for senior citizens, and the Patalaganga ropeway service are available for elderly and differently-abled devotees.
parking: Organized Pay & Park spaces and designated open lots are available near Nandi Circle and the Central Reception Office (CRO) zone, operating 24/7.
other_facilities: Satrams and Dharamshalas for pilgrim stay (historically funded since 1069 C.E. by Kalyana Chalukya grants).
Sri Gokulam Gosala maintaining over 1500 cows with dedicated veterinary care.
Production of Go Ark, incense sticks, Vibhuti, and dung cakes for Yagna at Sri Gokulam.
Srisaila Prabha Sales Counter & Information Counter located behind Sri Bhramaramba Devi Temple.
Accommodation and Annadaanam facilities at Tripuranthakam gateway.
